name: UNBUILT
description:
Turn plans into presence.

UNBUILT is an architectural motion template that transforms a single point into a line, a plan, a structure, and ultimately a place.

Built natively in Raylight using editable layers, spatial depth, camera movement, masks, typography, lighting, and architectural sequencing.

Designed for architecture, real-estate concepts, masterplans, project reveals, and spatial presentations.
